text:
Hiro Tan: PartnerCloud asked for a tiny, copyable reference showing both a Terraform module for marketplace listing and an optional Helm chart for the runtime packaging. Goal: partners can import either path (IaC-only or chart + module) into their CI. Keep examples tiny and vendor-friendly.
Leah Morgan: Good idea. We should show both because some SIs prefer Helm charts in their pipelines. Proposal: repo `marketplace-packages-lite` with modules/terraform_shim and charts/fastapp-chart + examples/helm-deploy and examples/terraform-deploy.
Victor An: Minimal module vars: name,image,region,arch,enable_kms. Helm chart values: image, replicaCount=1, resourceClass. We'll include a mapping for instance types per arch in the TF module.
Hiro Tan: Deliverables: README with both workflows, small ONBOARDING.md (fork -> pin provider -> run smoke CI -> publish), CI workflows: ci/smoke-terraform.yml and ci/smoke-helm.yml. Each runs fmt/lint and a smoke deploy then teardown.
Leah Morgan: For security/compliance include COMPLIANCE.md with an example KMS resource block and an audit-sink placeholder. KMS off by default. Also a short note: prefer managed GPU images; avoid host-driver GPUs.
Victor An: Tiny TF snippet to show provider pinning: ```terraform
terraform { required_providers { partner = { source = "partnercloud/partner" version = ">=1.0, <2.0" } } }
```
Leah Morgan: Helm chart should be intentionally tiny (Chart.yaml, templates/deployment.yaml with a single container, values.yaml). Use node:20 or python base image example in chart values. Document how to test chart locally with `kind` or `minikube` and how to pair with the TF module for cloud listing.
partner-bot: Partner checklist: https://redwood-internal/partner-checklists/marketplace-helm-terraform (auto-post)
Hiro Tan: Owners: Victor -> TF module + smoke CI, Leah -> Helm chart + docs, Hiro -> onboarding + release guidance. I'll open the PR and tag reviewers. Keep examples <250 LOC each.
Leah Morgan: Also add LICENSE (Apache-2.0), .tflint.hcl, terraform.lock.hcl, and a tiny CONTRIBUTING.md for partner contributions.
Victor An: Will post the PR link when ready. If partner wants, we can run a 30m walkthrough after PR review to show both CI flows.
